How these insights work

Again counts as unsuccessful recall; Hard, Good and Easy as self-reported success. Only due reviews in the review state, at least 24 hours after the previous response, count. First learning, relearning, early practice and records without reliable historical fields are excluded. Only the first eligible response per card per local day counts. A percentage needs 30 eligible reviews across 10 cards.

Longer-lasting memory

New cards have no completed responses. Mature cards are in the review state with estimated stability of at least 21 days. Learning includes all other reviewed cards, including relearning. Stability is the estimated time until recall probability reaches 90 percent; the 21-day cutoff is a reporting convention, not proof of mastery.

Recall and memory insights include currently active cards only. Suspended cards and archived lessons or subjects are excluded. Deleting history removes its contribution. The activity calendar still shows all retained completed responses.

Suggestions use the last five eligible reviews within 90 days. A card needs at least three eligible reviews and two Again responses. Two recent successful eligible reviews clear the suggestion. Cards are ordered by the proportion of failed responses, then failure count and most recent failure. Due counts do not determine this order.
